audience.text: Developers who need to generate or modify PowerPoint presentations on a server or in a build pipeline without installing PowerPoint, using COM interop, or relying on native dependencies.

capabilities.text: Create new presentations, open from file or stream, save to file or stream, and save subsets of slides.
capabilities.title: Create and edit presentations

capabilities.text: Add, insert, remove, clone, and hide slides; enumerate masters and layouts; clone masters.
capabilities.title: Slide management

capabilities.text: Add 187 auto shape types, picture frames, tables, and connectors; reorder z-order; adjust geometry values.
capabilities.title: Shape rendering

capabilities.text: Format text at portion level including bold, italic, underline, size, spacing, caps, and font selection.
capabilities.title: Text formatting

capabilities.text: Apply solid, gradient, pattern, picture, or no-fill to shapes, lines, text portions, and table cells.
capabilities.title: Fill and line styles

capabilities.text: Enable and configure eight effect types: outer shadow, inner shadow, glow, soft edge, reflection, blur, preset shadow, fill overlay.
capabilities.title: Visual effects

capabilities.text: Create tables with cell merging, borders, margins, and styles; add notes slides with footer and slide number visibility.
capabilities.title: Tables and notes

capabilities.text: Add comment authors and comments with position and timestamp; write core, extended, and custom document properties.
capabilities.title: Comments and document properties

limitations.text: Only three SaveFormat values are supported (.pptx, .ppsx, .potx); eighteen others raise NotSupportedException.
Does not support charts, animations, transitions, themes, backgrounds, group shapes, or hyperlinks.
Does not write modern threaded comments; only classic comment list format is supported.
Does not write language attributes to the XML; PowerPoint uses the authoring machine's default language.
Slide size cannot be changed; new presentations default to 4:3 screen size.
No overload for picture embedding accepts a file path; bytes must be read manually into a stream.

problems_solved.text: Enables server-side PowerPoint file generation and modification without requiring a local PowerPoint installation or COM interop.
Provides a pure .NET implementation that builds the PowerPoint Open XML package directly, with zero NuGet dependencies.
Supports precise control over presentation structure including slides, sections, shapes, text formatting, tables, effects, notes, and comments.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Slides.FOSS for .NET is an MIT-licensed .NET library that creates, reads, and edits PowerPoint .pptx presentations by building the Office Open XML package directly, with no external dependencies.

workflows.name: Create and save a basic presentation
workflows.text: Instantiate a Presentation, add shapes with text, and save to .pptx format using SaveFormat.Pptx.

workflows.name: Format text with character and paragraph styles
workflows.text: Set font height, bold, Latin font, fill color, and paragraph alignment on text portions within auto shapes.

workflows.name: Create and merge table cells
workflows.text: Add a table with specified row/column dimensions, populate cells, and merge cells horizontally or vertically.

workflows.name: Apply visual effects to shapes
workflows.text: Enable and configure effects such as outer shadow, including blur radius and distance, on auto shapes.

workflows.name: Add notes and comments
workflows.text: Create notes slides with notes text, add comment authors, and attach comments with position and timestamp.

workflows.name: Organize slides into sections
workflows.text: Add empty slides, then group them into named sections using Sections.AddSection.
